title: EBA IM-Model Validation Tracker
description: Deterministic roll-up arithmetic over a caller-declared internal-model inventory: counts by declared status (submitted, approved, rejected), lists pending ids in declared order, ages each pending submission in whole calendar days from its declared submitted date to the declared as_of date, and issues an overall verdict under a named 180-day aging rule (TRACKING_EMPTY, TRACKING_AGED, TRACKING_CURRENT). No register, no network, no clock.

as_of.description: Inventory snapshot date, YYYY-MM-DD; never a wall-clock read.

models.description: Declared model entries: { id, status (submitted|approved|rejected), submitted (YYYY-MM-DD) }, at most 4096.

approved.description: Count of models with declared status approved; null on the fail-closed path.

pending.description: Count of models with declared status submitted; null on the fail-closed path.

pending_ids.description: Pending model ids in declared order.

pending_age_days.description: Whole days from each pending model's submitted date to as_of, keyed by id.

trace.description: Per-pending aging sentences in declared order, or the fail-closed reasons naming each rejected input.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_eba_im_model_validation_tracker
mcp_tool_definition.description: Rolls up a caller-declared internal-model inventory: counts by declared status, lists pending submission ids, ages each pending submission in whole days to the declared as_of, and issues an overall verdict under a named 180-day aging rule. Tracker over declared synthetic inputs only: no register, no SSR tape, no cutoff feed, no network, no recommendation.

source: authored by EBA-IM-TRACKER-BUILD-1 per EBA-IM-TRACKER-BUILD-SPEC.md. Tracker positioning: arithmetic of a declared inventory under named rules, not a regulatory determination, not advice, and not a check of any live register, SSR tape, or cutoff feed (not_proven); absent or invalid inputs are refused fail-closed and named, never silently repaired.
